Who is the Projector?
20% of the Earth population

The Projector is a non-energy Type. In the Projector’s Rave Chart, the Sacred Centre is always undefined. In addition, the Projector often also has an undefined Throat. And if the Throat is defined, it is not connected to any of the three remaining Motor Centres - the Heart, Root and Solar Plexus. The Projector's defined Throat Centre can only be connected by channels to the Ajna, the G-centre or the Spleen.

With this configuration of Centres and Channels, each Projector is able to “read” the energy of those around them. The Projector's aura is a focused stream that always looks in one direction - at the other person. This probe provides the Projector with all the necessary information about that Person and their potential.

This makes Projectors the most effective executives and the wisest advisers. The main and exceptional gift of Projectors is the ability to steer the energy of representatives of other Types, especially Generators, in the right direction. The Projector’s evolutionary task is to identify the Generator’s potential on an energetic level and, with the help of knowledgeable questions or prompts, to unlock the Generator’s full natural potential.

Projectors are excellent advisers, skilful diplomats and ideal intermediaries between Manifestors and Generators - but only if their talents have been appreciated at their true value and they have been invited to interact.

You are able to integrate perfectly into society and develop your social connections in search of energy. You have a natural talent for connecting people in the correct way, thereby bringing the whole system of social interactions between Types into balance.

Reasons for Resistance in Your Life
Attempts to impose your value on another person

The fear that while they are waiting, other people will not be able to recognise them, leads Projectors to initiate social interactions and seek allies on their own.

When you try to help other people with advice or tips without being asked to do so, you will seem overly intrusive. Such behaviour is repulsive to others. Many people see the Projector's unsolicited advice as an attempt to teach them about life or simply to remake them to suit themselves.

You should not make a recommendation to another person unless you have received an invitation from them - even if you are acting in good faith and are fully convinced that you are right. The mechanics works in such a way that if there is no request and no invitation, your words will not reach the recipient. Rather, they will annoy the person and you will be very upset by this reaction.

Negative Manifestations (The “Not-Self”)
Feelings of bitterness, embitterment. Feeling of being unnecessary. Lack of motivation to develop.

The "Not - Self" is an emotional state or a physical sensation of a negative nature that arises every time you ignore your mechanics. For the Projector, that feeling is inner bitterness, a sense of frustration, sadness and anger.

These feelings arise as a result of you trying to help another person on your own initiative when they have not asked for your help or advice. In this case, instead of recognising your value and saying thank you, you will inevitably encounter resistance from them. If there is no resistance, it means that a person treats you with great respect. But they still will not hear you and will not want to use your recommendations.

The more social activity an incorrect Projector initiates, the more they are consumed with resentment towards other people and the world around them. Constantly bitter, the Projector can become embittered and retreat into deep social isolation.

The Projector’s Strategy and the Secret of their Effectiveness
Waiting for the moment when other people recognise your value and invite you to interact themselves.

The Projector's strategy boils down to patiently waiting for an invitation from others. After all, the Projector's true purpose is to care for the Generator’s well-being, and you can only access the Generator’s energy through mutual recognition of each other's value.

It is important for you to be noticed and invited to enter into interaction. Only then will you be able to access the other person's energy correctly. This applies to both simple everyday dialogue and more complex social communication.

It is only through an invitation that the Projector will be able to unleash their own abilities and talents. By moving correctly, you will get it right. Once you have been invited, you are able to fully recognise the inviter – and thus assess the benefit or “toxicity” of the energy you are trying to access. After all, your personal fulfilment depends directly on having the "right" people in your life - that is, those for whom your advice is truly valuable.

The Result that you will Receive as an Award
A state of success, recognition of your worth by others, personal growth.

Practical experience of Projectors living out their Design confirms - an invitation from the 'right' person comes precisely when the Projector is in a state of creative expectation - developing themselves and their talents, but taking no initiative in interaction with those around them. When you realise that what's most important to you is people who recognise you 100%, you start the cycle of building "your own" community. By working on the well-being of those close to you - and not just Generators - you are building an ideal community for you.

Here you no longer need to be recognised or wait for an invitation - it all already exists in an uninterrupted way and happens at a perfect rhythm, exactly in line with the rhythm of your life. By moving from invitation to invitation, you gain self-value and genuine recognition. In addition, you create a favourable environment for your development, the energy for which you receive after you have lived another success. The feeling of being needed and fulfilled become your constant companions.

Life Lesson
Waiting without initiating is the key to success and recognition of your talent

The realisation that the "right" people always come into your life on their own and you do not have to look for them. Understanding that self-fulfilment is only possible in interaction with such people.
